scope: Seven Java 1.21 architecture imports; natural placement is implemented separately in Underworld scripts.
limitations: Custom Java boss/mob encounter pools omitted.
Java trial-spawner and vault configurations are not ported; blocks retain default native behavior.
Java terrain carving and 128-block support pillar processors are not run.
Chests/barrels use Underworld loot. Vanilla spawners use native Nether mobs. Java item-frame entity omitted.
Nether Wart plants removed; Nether Wart construction blocks retained.

natural_generation.placement_tiles: Generated losslessly from converted sections by tools/generate_natural_landmarks.py; maximum 16 by 16 horizontal blocks
natural_generation.foundations: Anchors generated from existing solid template blocks by tools/generate_structure_foundations.py
natural_generation.discovery: Shared village lava-surface observations plus regional exploration; complete size assessments before weighted selection among confirmed fits
natural_generation.terrain_policy: Filtered ordinary Nether terrain carving; ocean coverage 60% Large / 55% Dragon / 35% Mega; supports placed after templates

modular_fortress.source: same credited source pieces and original connector graph
modular_fortress.policy: Keep and four required lower chambers preflighted; only the keep needs 90% lava; optional modules carve their authored envelope once, then stop only their own branch above 128 solid blocks or 2%; no hard natural-terrain carving rejection
modular_fortress.foundation_policy: Source red-glass pillar triggers become polished blackstone bricks; every authored ground/pier foot, including raised markers, fills air/lava down to existing solid terrain; unmarked decks stay suspended

foundation_mix.policy: All Mega foundations; deterministic coordinate pattern, 13/7 in complete 20-block bands, native vertical runs only during active generation

removed_spawn_suppressing_lights.scope: imported manual, natural, and modular structures only; source reference NBT retained
removed_spawn_suppressing_lights.method: replace with air and remove associated block entities

replacement_lighting.other_soul_lights: lit red candles where floor-supported; wall-only redstone torches
replacement_lighting.soul_campfires: Three lit red candles with supporting slabs upgraded to full double slabs; no continuous lighting scan

small_arena_spawners.change: replace zombie_pigman spawners; source reference NBT retained

underworld_trial_spawner_override.scope: All arena trial spawners and Mega Fortress keep/four basement chambers; optional modules retain regular spawners.
underworld_trial_spawner_override.pool: Explicit selected mob is mandatory. Initial weights: 25% Tower Wraith family / 25% Necromancer / 50% Brute. Potential pools retained but native reroll behavior remains unverified. Finite upgrade repair chooses and checkpoints explicit presets; no activation dependence on empty spawn_data.
underworld_trial_spawner_override.relocations: 31 new-template positions: Small 8, Large 18, Dragon 5; source Java files and hashes remain unchanged; current bedrock edits are recorded in TRIAL_ENCOUNTERS.json.
underworld_trial_spawner_override.migration: Finite revision migration updates existing indexed positions; legacy coordinates retained. No periodic scans.

dispenser_splash_override.policy: Replace imported dispenser splash water bottle slots offline; preserve counts, slots, and other ammunition; no runtime inventory scan

native_chest_pairing.policy: Restore reciprocal pairx/pairz/pairlead metadata while preserving independent native loot tables and authored contents; tile slicing translates partner coordinates; no runtime scanner

small_arena_ground.policy: Authored low-layer ground footprint for sampling/foundations; built-column mask for protected terrain checks and carving; unused manual/natural columns converted to structure void; bounded best-height ground survey; six-block cap and direct floor contact. Existing sites unchanged.
small_arena_ground.source_reference: Original Java hashes and licenses retained.

small_arena_chest_loot.scope: Retarget authored Small Arena chests in manual/natural templates; remove both from generic chests and wild root/sprout acquisition, retain cultivation harvests and test kit.
